title: Create a Temporary File
question: Create a temporary file and read back its contents.
code:
import tempfile
from pathlib import Path
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as folder:
    p = Path(folder) / 'note.txt'
    p.write_text('Hello', encoding='utf-8')
    print(p.read_text(encoding='utf-8'))
explanation: TemporaryDirectory cleans up its contents when the block ends.
